steps.label: open main.go
steps.eval: (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim().endsWith('main.go')&&!e.textContent.includes('_test')); r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick',{bubbles:true})); return !!r; })()

steps.label: R1.7 gopls status ready
steps.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<600;i++){const v=(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('[data-status=lang]'); return s&&s.dataset.state==='ready'&&s.textContent})();if(v)return v;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100))}return 'TIMEOUT'})()

steps.label: R7.1 error underline (unused var)
steps.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<300;i++){const v=(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('.cm-lintRange-error'); return e && e.textContent})();if(v)return v;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100))}return 'TIMEOUT'})()

steps.label: R12.2 completion latency ms (p50/p95 of 20)
steps.eval: (async()=>{const info=await window.go.rpc.AppService.Info();const p=info.projectPath+'/main.go';const t=[];let n=0;for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const s=performance.now();const r=await window.go.rpc.LangService.Completion(p,16,5);n=r.items.length;t.push(performance.now()-s)}t.sort((a,b)=>a-b);return {items:n,p50:Math.round(t[10]),p95:Math.round(t[18])}})()

steps.label: R3.1 completion popup after typing fmt.Pr
